final: WITH c AS (SELECT o.ordertune AS t, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS n FROM orders o JOIN riskandmargin r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.ordertune), a AS (SELECT AVG(n) AS avg_n FROM c) SELECT AVG(c.n) AS avg_count_above_average, AVG(c.n - a.avg_n) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM c, a WHERE c.n > a.avg_n
